hotels.title: Beachfront Thailand Island Paradise on Koh Phangan
hotels.description: The emerald waters, white sands and tropical jungle of Thailand’s Koh Phangan island await you at Buri Rasa Village Phangan. Nestled on the island’s northeast coast, this award-winning resort (rated among the top 1% worldwide on Tripadvisor) offers barefoot boutique style just steps from the beach. Indulge in authentic Thai and barbecue flavours overlooking the waves at The Beach Club, snorkel the colourful coral reef and submit to complete relaxation at Nam Thai Herbal Spa. While away the evenings at the resort’s charming village square, a cobblestoned street where you can enjoy a candlelit drink to the sounds of the ocean, or browse traditional Thai boutiques. Ready to explore? The resort offers excursions so you can immerse yourself in the beauty of the island. Don't miss sunset on Mae Haad Beach, the waterfalls and treks in Namtok Than Sadet National Park or the fantastic snorkelling at Haad Khom Beach.

hotels.title: Thailand Beachside Island Resort with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Cocktails & Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Embrace the best in laidback luxury with an idyllic beachside retreat in the glittering Gulf of Thailand. Positioned on a clifftop on one of the most beautiful islands in Thailand, this boutique resort is surrounded by coconut fields, lush tropical lowlands and picture-perfect beaches, offering some of the world's best dive spots. Soak up the untouched beauty of Koh Phangan from your enviable position, perched on a clifftop overlooking the pristine sands of Thong Nai Pan Noi Beach, one of the island’s most picturesque and serene beaches. Famed for its full moon parties, escape the crowds at this quiet corner of Koh Phangan, surrounded by waterfalls and lush tropical forest. Succumb to complete relaxation at Panviman Spa, snorkel the colourful coral reef, enjoy beachfront dishes showcasing Thai and international favourites at Stone Beach Restaurant or enjoy a candlelit drink at The Pool Deck to the sound of gently lapping ocean waves. When you're ready to explore, the resort offers a wealth of watersports, activities and excursions.
